tasks.short: Check payment requests against our rules and approve them within my authority.

today.trigger: A payment request arrives or Finance prepares a scheduled payment batch.
steps: Collect the request, invoice, supporting documents and budget owner approval.
Check AFAS for the outstanding amount, supplier details and earlier payments.
Check spending authority, payment terms and available cash.
Resolve missing approvals or disputed amounts with the requester and Bookkeeper.
Record the decision and pass approved payments to the authorised Rabobank signers.
drudgery: Opening several screens to check one payment.
Chasing documents and approvals.
Repeating checks already performed elsewhere in Finance.
today.time_sinks: Missing evidence, changed supplier bank details and approval queues consume more time than recording straightforward requests.

lenses.faster: AFAS data and written payment rules produce one checked approval pack. Reopening invoices, copying amounts and manually checking the authority matrix largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Each submitted request starts evidence collection and rule checks automatically. Complete requests enter the correct approval queue; exceptions return with a specific reason.
lenses.ambitious: Check every payment for duplicate references, unusual amounts and unsupported changes, including seasonal agency invoices. Track why requests fail so Finance can fix recurring problems upstream.
lenses.joy: Remove document hunting and routine approval chasing. Spend the remaining time resolving genuine disputes and protecting supplier relationships.
lenses.options: Compare paying on the due date, taking an available discount or negotiating a different date. Show the cash effect without proposing breaches of agreed terms.
lenses.altitude: Design the payment controls, authority limits and exception routes. Review samples and failure rates instead of rebuilding the evidence for every request.
reach: Bookkeeper: payment batch preparation and exception triage.
Accountant: duplicate-payment and supplier-master control testing.
Finance Director: preparation of short-term payment priorities.

tasks.human_edge: Recognise fraud, judge disputed business obligations and exercise delegated spending authority. An independent authorised signer releases money.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate coordinates documents, AFAS checks and approval routing. deterministic_software checks amounts and authority; an optional llm_step extracts request details but cannot authorise spending or change bank details.

in_practice.trigger: A request enters the configured AFAS approval workflow.
steps: Retrieve the request, outstanding item and approved supplier record using restricted access.
Extract missing structured fields from attachments and link them to the source documents.
Run duplicate, evidence, authority and cash checks; block incomplete or conflicting requests.
Present the checked request to the designated human approver and record the decision.
Prepare the approved batch through supported AFAS functionality for separate Rabobank signing.
Match bank results to approved requests and route rejected or unmatched payments.
in_practice.human_gate: A designated approver authorises each request under the authority matrix; separate bank signers release the batch. Supplier bank changes require independent verification.
systems: AFAS Profit approval workflow and payment functionality
Approved LLM service for attachment extraction, if needed
data_needed: Payment requests and supporting documents.
Outstanding items and prior payment identifiers.
Approved supplier bank records and change status.
Authority matrix, payment policy and cash availability timestamp.
Bank batch acknowledgements and statements.
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS request and payment records, with linked evidence, rule versions, approver identities and bank results in a restricted SharePoint control register.

evidence.claim: AFAS payment functionality can exclude items with bank accounts awaiting approval and locks invoices during an active payment order.
Rabobank supports a second signature for payments and batches according to configured user limits.
The proposed workflow could save 55% of Controller effort and complete requests 1.7 times faster; these are untested estimates.

risks: Combining supplier maintenance, request approval and bank signing under one identity defeats segregation of duties.
A changed bank account can pass document checks while still being fraudulent; verify through a trusted independent channel.
Instructions embedded in an invoice could mislead an LLM; attachments must be treated as data and the model must have no payment authority.
Approval waiting time may dominate elapsed time even after preparation becomes faster.
research_questions: How much of the 147.1 annual hours is preparation, approval waiting, exception handling or bank signing?
Which checks and approval routes are already configured in AFAS, and which are repeated manually?
Can the available interfaces prepare requests and batches without giving the integration bank-signing or supplier-change rights?
In a shadow run, does the workflow identify every known duplicate, unauthorised request and unverified bank change?

tasks.short: Check cash, reserves and financial obligations, and flag anything that could put us out of compliance.

today.trigger: The daily financial extract becomes available, a bank statement arrives or an obligation approaches its deadline.
steps: Collect bank balances, AFAS receivables, payables and payroll commitments.
Update the cash overview and distinguish available cash from restricted amounts.
Check upcoming obligations against the approved compliance calendar and financing agreements.
Investigate unusual movements, missing payments or apparent threshold breaches.
Report issues to the Finance Director and assign follow-up actions.
drudgery: Rebuilding the same cash overview.
Checking unchanged deadlines and thresholds.
Tracing differences between bank balances and last night's dashboard.
today.time_sinks: Reconciling data from different timestamps and determining whether an alert represents a real breach or incomplete data.

lenses.faster: A scheduled reconciliation calculates balances, commitments and threshold headroom. Manual exports and repeated calendar checks become exception review.
lenses.autonomous: A successful source refresh starts the checks and assigns alerts to named owners. Failed or stale feeds produce a data-quality alert rather than a reassuring compliance status.
lenses.ambitious: Monitor every applicable obligation and track the evidence that it was met. Add an early-warning view of cash pressure from seasonal flex staffing and slow customer receipts.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated balance copying and deadline checking. Focus on preventing a cash problem before it disrupts wages or supplier payments.
lenses.options: Show base, delayed-receipt and higher-agency-cost cash paths. Separate contractual covenant thresholds, legally restricted reserves and management cash buffers.
lenses.altitude: Own the control catalogue, source freshness standards and escalation rules. Test whether the monitoring system detects failures and whether owners resolve them.
reach: Credit and Collections Officer: prioritisation of receipts that matter most to liquidity.
Accountant: financial control evidence collection.
Finance Director: treasury and covenant monitoring preparation.

tasks.human_edge: Interpret ambiguous obligations, assess materiality and decide corrective action. Legal and tax specialists validate requirements; the Controller cannot infer compliance from a green dashboard.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software handles reconciliations, deadlines and approved formulas with checkable outputs. An optional llm_step drafts alert explanations from evidence; it does not determine legal requirements.

in_practice.trigger: A scheduled check runs after source refresh, or a newly received bank statement changes the cash position.
steps: Load timestamped AFAS and bank data and reject incomplete or stale inputs.
Reconcile balances and calculate committed cash and headroom using approved formulas.
Check the versioned obligation calendar, reserve classifications and financing thresholds.
Create evidence-linked alerts with owners, deadlines and escalation levels.
Record resolutions and produce a daily status view with explicit coverage and data timestamps.
in_practice.human_gate: The Controller handles exceptions and periodically reviews coverage; the Finance Director approves corrective actions and changes to thresholds. Tax or legal advisers validate changes to legal obligations.
data_needed: Bank balances, statement timestamps and reconciliation items.
Receivables, payables, payroll and scheduled payment commitments.
Signed financing agreements and approved covenant definitions.
Applicable tax and filing calendar with accountable owners.
Approved classifications of restricted reserves and cash buffers.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint financial control register containing source timestamps, calculation versions, alerts, acknowledgements and resolution evidence.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors retrieve configured Profit data for external processing; the proposed control engine still requires implementation.
Power BI supports scheduled refresh and refresh-failure notifications; this does not make Noordhaven's nightly AFAS extract live.
The proposed monitoring could save 50% of effort and complete checks 1.8 times faster once reliable feeds and rules exist.

risks: Nightly AFAS data can omit today's payments and commitments; every status must show its effective time.
Incorrect covenant definitions or an incomplete obligation calendar create false assurance.
Management cash buffers, restricted equity reserves and contractual covenants have different meanings and must not be combined.
Excessive low-value alerts can hide a material cash or compliance problem.
research_questions: Which actual legal obligations, reserve restrictions and financing covenants apply to Noordhaven?
Are bank and AFAS feeds timely enough for daily liquidity decisions, including payroll days?
Can approved formulas reproduce historical covenant calculations and known exceptions?
Does a shadow run detect missing data and missed obligations without overwhelming the Controller?

tasks.short: Recommend how to fund cash gaps and what to do with temporary cash surpluses.

today.trigger: The cash forecast shows a gap or surplus, or management proposes a major investment.
steps: Collect the latest cash forecast, debt terms and proposed capital spending.
Review seasonal staffing, payroll, customer receipts and supplier commitments.
Model funding needs and the timing of any surplus in Excel.
Compare permitted funding or surplus-placement choices using current terms.
Discuss assumptions with FP&A and recommend an action to the Finance Director.
drudgery: Rebuilding cash schedules for each scenario.
Copying facility terms and recalculating interest.
Updating the same recommendation after assumptions change.
today.time_sinks: Obtaining credible payment timing and current financing terms, then testing whether apparent surplus cash is truly available.

lenses.faster: One validated cash model recalculates financing needs when assumptions change. AI drafts the comparison from its outputs, removing spreadsheet duplication and repeated memo writing.
lenses.autonomous: A revised forecast or approved investment request triggers an updated option pack. Borrowing, transfers and investments require human decisions.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a rolling 13-week cash view and test funding pressure before peak staffing periods. Compare predicted gaps with actual outcomes to improve the assumptions.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive modelling and formatting. Keep the judgement about uncertainty and the discussions with management and the bank.
lenses.options: Compare permitted facility drawdowns, delaying discretionary capital spending and accelerating customer receipts. For genuine surpluses, compare policy-approved placements with debt repayment and retaining liquidity.
lenses.altitude: Set the liquidity policy, scenario assumptions and decision thresholds. Evaluate forecast reliability instead of rebuilding the cash model for each recommendation.
reach: FP&A Analyst: cash scenario modelling.
Credit and Collections Officer: translating collection plans into cash timing.
Finance Director: preparation for funding discussions with Rabobank.

tasks.human_edge: Judge how much uncertainty the company can absorb, negotiate financing terms and balance liquidity against operational commitments.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot supports a human-led funding recommendation. deterministic_software calculates cash and financing costs; an LLM explains differences and challenges assumptions without choosing or executing a transaction.

in_practice.trigger: FP&A approves a new cash forecast or management submits a capital expenditure proposal.
steps: Load the approved cash forecast, commitments and current signed facility terms.
Calculate base and stress scenarios with traceable formulas and no invented rates.
Filter choices against the approved liquidity policy and contractual constraints.
Draft an option comparison with cash timing, costs, risks and unresolved assumptions.
Let the Controller challenge the assumptions and submit a recommendation for Finance Director approval.
in_practice.human_gate: The Controller owns the recommendation; the Finance Director approves funding or surplus-placement decisions. Authorised staff execute approved transactions separately.
systems: Rabobank statements and supplied facility terms
data_needed: Receivable timing assumptions informed by collection history.
Supplier, payroll and tax payment schedules.
Approved staffing agency orders and capital commitments.
Current facility availability, rates, fees and covenant conditions.
Liquidity policy, minimum cash buffer and permitted counterparties.
in_practice.logs_to: A versioned SharePoint treasury decision file containing model inputs, scenarios, source terms, recommendations, approvals and subsequent outcomes.

evidence.claim: Excel can use refreshable tables and PivotTables connected to Power BI data, reducing repeated imports.
A formula-based cash model can compare approved funding options while an LLM drafts the explanation.
A 40% effort reduction and 1.5 times end-to-end speedup are pilot hypotheses, including continued human review.

risks: Expected receipts may be treated as certain despite disputed invoices or overdue customers.
Old rates or misunderstood facility conditions can reverse the ranking of options.
Double-counting agency commitments and their invoices overstates funding needs.
A plausible narrative can conceal a weak downside scenario or unavailable financing.
research_questions: How accurate is the current cash forecast at one, four and thirteen weeks?
Are signed facility terms and permitted surplus placements available in a structured, current form?
Can the model reproduce actual seasonal funding needs without double-counting commitments?
Does the option pack materially improve decisions beyond the existing FP&A cash model?

tasks.short: Coordinate budgets and financial plans across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.

today.trigger: The annual budget cycle, forecast revision or a significant spending proposal begins.
steps: Agree the timetable, templates and assumptions with the Finance Director and FP&A.
Request site plans, staffing assumptions and procurement commitments.
Consolidate submissions and check them against AFAS actuals.
Challenge inconsistencies and negotiate changes with site managers.
Obtain decisions, publish the approved plan and track actions.
drudgery: Chasing submissions and identifying the latest spreadsheet.
Fixing inconsistent site templates.
Rewriting meeting actions and checking whether they were completed.
today.time_sinks: Waiting for credible site assumptions and resolving competing priorities; consolidation is only part of the work.

lenses.faster: Standard submissions and automatic validation remove spreadsheet repairs and repeated consolidation. AI prepares focused questions and draft action lists for the planning meetings.
lenses.autonomous: An approved planning calendar opens submission requests and reminders automatically. Submitted plans receive completeness checks before reaching the Controller.
lenses.ambitious: Run a monthly rolling forecast with common drivers across all three sites. Make labour, flex staffing and capital assumptions explicit enough to explain forecast misses.
lenses.joy: Remove version hunting and administrative chasing. Keep constructive challenge and agreement on what each site can deliver.
lenses.options: Compare site plans under several volume, wage and flex-worker assumptions. Show the trade-offs between service capacity, margin and cash.
lenses.altitude: Design the planning process and shared driver definitions. Judge assumption quality and decision follow-through rather than managing spreadsheet traffic.
reach: FP&A Analyst: routine consolidation and forecast administration.
HR Business Partner: coordination of aggregated workforce cost assumptions.
Site management: preparation of financially consistent spending proposals.

tasks.human_edge: Secure credible commitments from site managers, resolve conflicts and distinguish realistic plans from convenient targets.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot supports coordination and challenge led by the Controller. deterministic_software validates and consolidates submissions; the human negotiates priorities and obtains commitments.

in_practice.trigger: The Finance Director approves the planning calendar or requests a forecast revision.
steps: Open standard site submissions with approved assumptions, owners and deadlines.
Validate submitted figures, reconcile actuals and identify missing drivers.
Consolidate approved versions and calculate alternative scenarios.
Prepare an evidence-linked challenge brief and proposed meeting agenda.
Capture agreed decisions, obtain approval and publish the authorised plan with assigned actions.
in_practice.human_gate: The Controller leads challenge meetings; site owners confirm assumptions and the Finance Director approves the consolidated plan.
data_needed: Actual revenue and costs by site and consistent cost-centre mappings.
Approved volume and capacity assumptions supplied by operations.
Aggregated staffing, shift, CAO wage and flex-worker cost assumptions.
Procurement and capital commitments.
Submission owners, deadlines and approval status.
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint planning register with submission versions, validation results, approved assumptions, decisions and action owners.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports financial budgets, comparisons with actuals and budget-related signals.
Standardised submissions and evidence-based AI briefs can reduce consolidation and meeting preparation effort.
The estimated 30% effort saving and 1.2 times elapsed speedup depend on site participation and approval timing.

risks: Fast consolidation can spread inconsistent volume or cost definitions across the whole plan.
Automated reminders cannot solve disagreement about capacity or ownership.
Individual employee data may enter planning files when aggregated staffing costs would suffice.
Workforce proposals may require HR review and applicable OR procedures before implementation.
research_questions: How much planning time is spent consolidating files versus negotiating assumptions and decisions?
Will all three sites use common driver definitions and submission templates?
Which operational volume and capacity inputs exist outside the listed systems, and who owns them?
Does a trial reduce planning turnaround while improving forecast accuracy and site ownership?

tasks.short: Advise management on financial goals and the actions needed to achieve them.

today.trigger: Management reviews results, considers a strategic decision or asks for financial advice.
steps: Clarify the decision, objectives and available choices.
Collect financial results, forecasts and relevant operational assumptions.
Analyse consequences for margin, cash and financial risk.
Prepare a recommendation and discuss it with management.
Record the decision and agree how its results will be measured.
drudgery: Reassembling familiar figures for each management discussion.
Formatting slides and rewriting financial explanations.
Searching previous decisions for the assumptions behind them.
today.time_sinks: Framing the actual choice, checking uncertain assumptions and building agreement among managers.

lenses.faster: AI prepares a sourced decision brief from approved figures and previous decisions. Repeated chart assembly and first-draft writing shrink.
lenses.autonomous: A management agenda item or material forecast deviation creates a draft briefing. Advice and commitments remain with the Controller and management.
lenses.ambitious: Give important decisions a measurable financial hypothesis and review the outcome later. Build a record of which assumptions repeatedly fail.
lenses.joy: Remove slide production and repetitive explanation writing. Spend more time helping managers understand consequences and make sound choices.
lenses.options: Develop five credible alternatives, including continuing the current approach, with cash, margin and execution consequences. Expose the assumptions that would change the recommendation.
lenses.altitude: Improve how management makes financial decisions. Set standards for evidence, uncertainty and outcome review.
reach: FP&A Analyst: preparation of scenario narratives.
Finance Director: preparation of management decision papers.
HR Director: financial analysis of workforce proposals using aggregated data.

tasks.human_edge: Understand management incentives, challenge attractive but weak proposals and take responsibility for the advice given.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot drafts briefs, alternatives and counterarguments while the Controller leads the decision. The value depends on judgement, trust and the ability to challenge management.

in_practice.trigger: The Controller selects a management decision or forecast issue for analysis.
steps: Define the decision, constraints and evaluation criteria with the Controller.
Retrieve approved financial figures and relevant prior decisions with source links.
Calculate alternatives in validated models and identify missing evidence.
Draft a brief separating facts, assumptions, uncertainties and recommendations.
Let the Controller revise and present the advice, then record the decision and review date.
in_practice.human_gate: The Controller checks every recommendation and leads the management discussion; management approves policy and strategic actions.
data_needed: Approved actuals and forecasts.
Decision objectives and operational constraints.
Validated scenario calculations.
Previous decisions, assumptions and measured outcomes.
Relevant company policies and contractual commitments.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint decision register with source figures, reviewed advice, management decisions, owners and outcome reviews.

evidence.claim: LLMs can draft decision briefs and counterarguments from supplied evidence, subject to human verification.
The projected 30% effort saving and 1.2 times end-to-end speedup mainly concern preparation; management deliberation still takes time.

risks: A polished recommendation may obscure uncertain assumptions or unsupported causal claims.
Generating several options does not make their underlying financial model correct.
Confidential strategy and customer economics require restricted access and an approved model environment.
Management may treat an AI draft as approved Controller advice unless its status is explicit.
research_questions: Which recurring advice requests consume the most preparation time?
Can each numerical claim in a trial briefing be traced to an approved figure or calculation?
Do managers find the alternatives more useful than the current briefing format?
Does the process improve decision follow-through and forecast trust, beyond saving slide-writing time?

tasks.short: Budget employee benefits and insurance, and check the financial exposure with HR.

today.trigger: An insurance renewal, benefits budget, policy change or material claim requires financial review.
steps: Collect policy terms, premiums, payroll totals and aggregated claims information.
Confirm with HR and Compensation and Benefits which arrangements apply to each employee group.
Reconcile premiums, reimbursements and benefit costs to AFAS.
Model renewal costs, uninsured exposure and benefit budget changes.
Review the proposal with HR, the broker and the Finance Director before recording approvals.
drudgery: Comparing differently formatted policy and renewal documents.
Rekeying premium tables and covered payroll totals.
Tracing reimbursements and premium adjustments.
today.time_sinks: Understanding coverage exclusions, reconciling the insured population and separating HR administration from financial oversight.

lenses.faster: AI extracts policy terms into a reviewed comparison table; rules reconcile premiums and coverage bases. Manual document comparison and repeated budget calculations shrink.
lenses.autonomous: A renewal document or approved payroll update triggers a draft reconciliation and budget comparison. Policy changes and claim decisions require the responsible humans.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a financial view of sickness-pay exposure, WGA arrangements, accident cover and contractual benefits. Identify coverage gaps before renewal instead of discovering them during a claim.
lenses.joy: Remove policy-table copying and premium matching. Keep the conversations about useful cover, fair benefits and acceptable financial exposure.
lenses.options: Compare current cover, alternative deductibles and benefit packages against approved broker quotations. Show premium savings alongside the additional retained risk.
lenses.altitude: Design the financial controls around benefits and insurance. HR owns employee arrangements and case handling; the Controller owns cost, reconciliation and exposure analysis.
reach: Compensation and Benefits Specialist: benefits cost modelling.
Payroll Specialist: reconciliation of insured salary bases and premiums.
HR Director: financial preparation for insurance renewals and benefit proposals.

tasks.human_edge: Interpret coverage with the broker, balance employee interests against cost and judge uncertain liabilities. HR and medical professionals retain responsibility for individual employee cases.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate combines an llm_step for policy extraction with deterministic premium and budget calculations. HR, the Controller and the broker verify interpretation before any policy or benefits change.

in_practice.trigger: HR uploads a renewal quotation or requests a benefits budget revision.
steps: Retrieve current and proposed policy documents plus approved aggregated employee-group totals.
Extract premiums, insured bases, exclusions and dates with page-level references and flag ambiguity.
Reconcile costs to AFAS and calculate scenarios using reviewed policy terms.
Prepare a financial comparison covering premiums, retained exposure and unresolved questions.
Obtain HR, broker and financial approval, including applicable OR procedures, before implementing changes.
in_practice.human_gate: HR validates employee arrangements, the broker confirms coverage interpretation and the Finance Director approves financial commitments. The OR is involved where the proposed personnel arrangement requires it.
systems: SharePoint with separate HR and Finance permissions
data_needed: Current policies, renewal quotations, exclusions and insured payroll definitions.
Aggregated eligible employee counts and salary bases by arrangement.
Applicable provisions of CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer and the warehouse CAO.
Premium invoices, reimbursements and approved aggregate claims costs.
HR-approved assumptions about sickness-pay and other retained financial exposure.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint insurance and benefits register containing extracted terms, document references, reconciliations and approvals; medical records are excluded.

evidence.claim: Document extraction with source references can support policy comparisons, but insurance interpretation needs specialist review.
The proposed comparison and reconciliation workflow could save 40% of effort and finish reviews 1.4 times faster.

risks: A US-style workers' compensation or employer health-insurance model would misrepresent Dutch arrangements; verify actual policies, CAO benefits and sickness-pay exposure.

Medical diagnoses must not enter Finance or general AI processing; use necessary financial data and appropriately aggregated exposure information. [AP guidance](https://autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/themas/werk-en-uitkering/zieke-werknemers/regels-voor-werkgevers-bij-zieke-werknemers)

Under Wet verbetering poortwachter, deficient re-integration can create additional wage exposure; HR owns the process and Finance models approved assumptions. [UWV assessment guidance](https://www.uwv.nl/nl/ziek/re-integratie/beoordeling-re-integratieverslag)

Personnel arrangement changes can require OR consent. Extending AI from aggregate costing to decisions affecting individuals' employment terms requires a separate EU AI Act assessment. [OR rights](https://www.rijksoverheid.nl/documenten/vraag-en-antwoord/ondernemingsraad/rechten-ondernemingsraad-or), [European Commission employment guidance](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/employment-0)
research_questions: Which benefits and insurance activities does the Controller actually own versus HR, Compensation and Benefits and the broker?
Can the financial work be completed using aggregated costs and eligibility totals without medical or individual claims details?
Does document extraction reproduce every material exclusion and coverage condition in a broker-reviewed sample?
Which proposed changes require CAO interpretation, OR involvement or additional privacy assessment?

tasks.short: Check that payroll deductions, payments and ledger balances agree.

today.trigger: The Payroll Specialist prepares a payroll run, correction or payroll-related remittance.
steps: Receive the payroll control totals, deduction reports and proposed payroll journal.
Review material changes against approved payroll and CAO settings.
Reconcile deductions to the journal, remittance schedules and ledger balances.
Investigate exceptions with the Payroll Specialist and Accountant.
Approve the financial reconciliation and pass payments to authorised signers.
drudgery: Copying payroll totals into reconciliation spreadsheets.
Matching the same deduction categories each period.
Tracing retrospective corrections across reports.
today.time_sinks: Explaining differences caused by corrections, payment timing and component mappings; AFAS already performs the core payroll calculations.

lenses.faster: Use AFAS's calculated payroll outputs and automate the financial reconciliation. Manual copying and repeated matching disappear while the Controller reviews exceptions.
lenses.autonomous: A provisional or corrected payroll run triggers reconciliation and variance checks. Payroll release and deduction-rule changes stay behind human approval.
lenses.ambitious: Check all relevant deduction balances every run and track unresolved differences through settlement. Test corrections and unusual shift-pay cases systematically.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive payroll-to-ledger matching. Keep the investigation of genuine errors before employees or authorities receive the wrong amounts.
lenses.options: Show which differences arise from timing, retrospective changes or incorrect mappings. Test alternative explanations against the actual payroll components instead of generating alternative deduction amounts.
lenses.altitude: Own the reconciliation rules and assurance evidence. Let the Payroll Specialist own payroll calculation settings and CAO interpretation.
reach: Accountant: payroll balance-sheet reconciliation.
Payroll Specialist: financial exception triage and control evidence preparation.
Finance Director: consolidated assurance over payroll-related payments.

tasks.human_edge: Resolve unusual deductions, confirm lawful treatment with Payroll and challenge configuration changes. Deterministic calculations and accountable review protect employees' pay.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software is appropriate because payroll deductions already follow configured rules in AFAS. AI can help build reconciliation code and explain exceptions; an LLM must not calculate statutory deductions.

in_practice.trigger: AFAS produces a provisional payroll run, payroll correction or payroll journal.
steps: Retrieve calculated component totals, payroll journal lines and remittance schedules.
Reconcile using approved component mappings and explicit rules for retrospective corrections.
Compare material movements with prior runs and approved payroll changes.
Route differences to Payroll or Accounting with source references and proposed explanations.
Obtain Controller approval of the reconciliation and Payroll approval of the run before separate payment authorisation.
in_practice.human_gate: The Controller approves each financial reconciliation; the Payroll Specialist approves payroll settings and the run. Authorised bank signers approve payments.
data_needed: Calculated payroll components and deduction control totals.
Payroll journals, ledger balances and remittance schedules.
Approved payroll changes and effective-dated mappings.
CAO assignment and validated treatment of the own warehouse CAO.
Retrospective correction references and payment confirmations.
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted AFAS payroll control records and a linked SharePoint reconciliation register containing rule versions, differences, resolutions and approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS provides analyses for reconciling calculated payroll components, journals and payroll declaration amounts.
AFAS supports payroll declaration processing and configured automatic payment of payroll tax through Profit Finance.
The estimated 50% effort saving and 1.4 times end-to-end speedup apply to Controller checks beyond existing payroll automation.

risks: Counting AFAS's existing calculation automation as a new AI saving overstates the opportunity.
Payroll declarations and journals do not always align one-to-one because of correction timing; naïve matching creates false exceptions.
The own warehouse CAO may require configured components and testing rather than assumed standard vendor coverage.
Agency workers' wages generally sit with their staffing employer; reconcile Noordhaven's agency invoices separately from its employee payroll.
Payroll data requires restricted AVG/GDPR access; broad AI access to payslips or sensitive deduction details is unnecessary for aggregate checks.
research_questions: What does the Controller currently recalculate, and what is already calculated or reconciled by AFAS and Payroll?
Can approved rules explain historical retrospective corrections and declaration-to-journal timing differences?
Are the two CAO assignments and warehouse-specific payroll components configured and tested correctly?
Does a parallel run reproduce all control totals and catch known errors with fewer manual checks?

tasks.short: Prepare the financial reporting pack and make sure the figures and forecast hold together.

today.trigger: Month close, a budget or forecast deadline, year-end reporting or an applicable regulatory deadline arrives.
steps: Agree reporting readiness with the Accountants and FP&A Analysts.
Collect AFAS balances, reconciliations, approved adjustments and forecast inputs.
Map figures into statement, budget and management reporting templates.
Check consistency and investigate material movements or missing accruals.
Draft commentary, obtain approvals and distribute or submit the approved reports.
drudgery: Moving the same figures between spreadsheets, reports and slides.
Checking whether every report uses the same version.
Writing repetitive commentary about movements already visible in the numbers.
today.time_sinks: Waiting for reconciled balances and agreed forecast assumptions, then resolving cut-off issues and inconsistent report versions.

lenses.faster: Generate tables from one approved reporting snapshot and draft commentary from calculated movements. Repeated copying, formatting and cross-report tie-outs largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Completion of the close readiness checklist triggers a draft pack. Unreconciled balances or stale data block release rather than quietly entering the report.
lenses.ambitious: Provide earlier provisional management views and a final reconciled pack with clear status. Track forecast errors and audit adjustments back to the assumptions or controls that caused them.
lenses.joy: Remove report assembly and repetitive commentary. Keep explaining performance, challenging estimates and helping the business trust the forecast.
lenses.options: Show approved base, upside and downside forecasts alongside one reconciled set of actuals. Separate data-supported movements from explanations still awaiting confirmation.
lenses.altitude: Own reporting definitions, close readiness and evidence quality. Improve the reporting system instead of assembling each pack manually.
reach: Accountant: routine statement assembly and reporting tie-outs.
FP&A Analyst: first-draft forecast commentary and scenario presentation.
Finance Director: preparation of management and external reporting packs.

tasks.human_edge: Judge material estimates, accounting treatment, disclosures and the credibility of the forecast. The Controller and Finance Director remain accountable for released reports.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate coordinates close evidence, report assembly and release approval. deterministic_software builds and checks figures; an llm_step drafts sourced commentary for Controller review.

in_practice.trigger: The reporting deadline approaches and designated owners confirm close or forecast readiness.
steps: Create a dated reporting snapshot after checking source completeness and refresh status.
Run reconciliation, mapping, cut-off and cross-report consistency checks; flag unresolved items.
Generate statements and reporting tables from approved definitions and forecast versions.
Draft commentary with links to numerical movements and confirmed business explanations.
Obtain Controller and Finance Director approval before distribution or authorised external submission.
Archive the released version and record subsequent corrections and forecast outcomes.
in_practice.human_gate: The Controller approves the pack and material estimates; the Finance Director approves release. External filings use the applicable reporting requirements and designated submission authority.
data_needed: Trial balance, reconciliations and approved journal adjustments.
Reporting mappings, templates and materiality thresholds.
Approved forecast drivers, budget versions and business explanations.
Unbilled revenue, supplier and staffing accrual evidence where applicable.
Close readiness status, applicable reporting obligations and approval authorities.
in_practice.logs_to: A versioned SharePoint reporting archive linked to AFAS balances, reconciliation evidence, commentary sources, approval records and released reports.

evidence.claim: AFAS provides a financial reporting cockpit and configurable reporting structures; Noordhaven's required external filing format still needs verification.
AFAS provides profit-and-loss reporting against budget with configurable comparison periods.
The proposed assembly workflow could save 55% of this task's effort and deliver packs 1.5 times faster; it does not imply the whole month close becomes 1.5 times faster.

risks: A nightly Power BI refresh may miss late close journals; the released snapshot must reconcile to the approved AFAS balances.
Incorrect mappings or incomplete accrual evidence can create consistent-looking but wrong statements.
AI commentary may invent causes for variances; unconfirmed explanations must be labelled and reviewed.
Management reporting templates may not meet statutory reporting requirements; verify Noordhaven's actual reporting classification and obligations.
Faster pack assembly will not shorten close if unresolved accounting work remains the bottleneck.
research_questions: How much of the 51.7 annual hours is pack assembly versus accounting judgement and coordination?
Can every report reconcile to one approved AFAS snapshot, including journals posted after the nightly extract?
Which reporting and filing requirements actually apply, and can the proposed templates meet them?
Over several closes, do days to close and forecast accuracy improve without increasing audit adjustments?

role.altitude: The Controller becomes the owner of financial control quality and decision evidence across payment, liquidity, payroll and reporting workflows. The role focuses on exceptions, assumptions and whether management can trust the forecast.
reach: Bookkeeper: payment preparation and routine payment exception triage.
Accountant: automated reconciliation oversight, reporting tie-outs and control evidence.
FP&A Analyst: cash scenarios, planning consolidation and first-draft forecast explanations.
Finance Director: preparation of treasury decisions and management reporting.
Compensation and Benefits Specialist and HR Director: aggregated benefits costing and insurance exposure analysis.
role.ceiling_note: The described current workflows are hypotheses for this fictional company. These eight tasks total 725.2 hours, about 45.3% of the supplied role time; the estimates imply about 326 hours of annual capacity, worth roughly EUR 31,000 at EUR 95/hour before implementation and operating costs. This is capacity value, not an assumed cash saving or a forecast for the unlisted work. Time_saved_pct measures Controller effort; speedup estimates elapsed task completion including automation and human waiting. Both require pilots. Existing AFAS automation, data freshness, site participation, specialist judgement and independent approvals limit the gains; shared improvements across tasks must not be counted twice.
skills_to_grow: Translate financial policies into testable rules, thresholds and exception routes.
Understand AFAS connectors, permissions, payroll mappings and reporting definitions.
Build and validate cash and forecast models in Excel and Power BI.
Check AI-generated explanations against sources and distinguish facts from assumptions.
Measure control failures, forecast accuracy, close bottlenecks and realised time savings.
Apply segregation of duties, AVG/GDPR access controls and relevant OR procedures.
Develop AI literacy and assess proposed uses before extending financial support into decisions about individual workers.
Challenge site assumptions and communicate financial choices clearly to management.
role.ambitious_version: Run a financial control and planning system that checks routine transactions, keeps a reliable 13-week cash forecast and assembles reconciled reporting packs. Use the released capacity to investigate forecast misses, improve site assumptions and remove recurring close delays. Judge success by fewer days to close with a trusted forecast, supported by forecast accuracy, DSO, invoices processed without touch and audit adjustments.
